name: Riverbend Drive
author: Schnuck01
style: Two-storey two-tone brick family traditional on a riverside lot: one long side-gabled ridge with a single dormer, three wall gables across the front (brick over the garage, a tall brick centre gable, a whitewashed gable over a recessed glazed entry), a pent roof over the garage, a bay under its own hip, a lower hipped east wing with the hearth chimney; a rock-edged stream and topiary cones in front, a lily pond and willow on the west lawn, the river behind
